title: Story premise EDU077: The Shade Moves Across the Square
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (environment/ecology). Hook: Does this bench stay shaded after the camera stops? Takeaway/theme: Shade is spatial and time-dependent; one snapshot cannot describe a whole day.
description: A planner wants to compare two public-square designs, but judges tree shade from one static noon image. A time sweep shows where shadows travel and what the simplified model leaves unmeasured.
